summary: The plain GCS and much of the Pi/laptop runtime were implemented and software-tested. I did not complete the requested final flight qualification, campaign or physical integration. The latest Pi connection reached disarmed preflight observation, not a completed mission.
accountability: I spent substantial effort fixing GCS migration, Pi deployment and network/sensor integration. I did not carry that work through the required final complete suite and matching-source flights. Working screens, Accepted receipts and green focused tests are insufficient to call the whole system ready. I am not assigning a completion percentage because software items and flight qualification gates are different obligations.
stop_state: No AeroTHON simulator, gateway relay or camera/telemetry recorder was found active on the laptop at the stop check. Pi HTTP and SSH at 192.168.0.100 timed out, so its current process and armed state could not be confirmed. Last saved Pi telemetry was idle, STABILIZE and disarmed. No mission Start or arm command was sent during the latest Pi integration. No further feature work or qualification run was started to write this report.

gcs_instructions: Replace the old GCS with the plain interface we designed, with Flight operations and Testing, neutral themes, readable text and thin dividers.
Host the GCS and production algorithms on the Pi; run only Gazebo, SITL and a connection gateway on the laptop.
Make profiles detailed and editable for changing addresses, FCU transports, identity, devices, sensor gateway, calibration and RC mappings. Keep DDS local to the Pi.
Use the same production mission and component algorithms in both deployments, with one movement owner, explicit Start, recovery and transmitter takeover.
Provide full mission, manual SLAM, transmitter and route avoidance, QR, banner, mechanism and position/GPS delivery tests.
Restore map loading, all 20 production arena dimensions, flight/sensor graphs, vibration and magnetic indications, plus explicit stale/unavailable data.
Initially allow a standalone receive-only telemetry GCS without algorithms; later merge it into the requested command-capable shared production runtime.
Replace stale Pi code and services, preserve recovery copies and measured configuration, and work directly in main without new worktrees.
Make green, orange and red banner colours operator-supplied hex codes, and apply them through the GCS to perception.
At this stop, keep the report and project in the AEROTHON working folder, remove extra worktrees after preservation, and keep one maintained GCS.

failures.resolution: Later navigation and calm mission subsets improved. Current-source rendered closure is still missing.

failures.outcome: A focused native trial passed seven geometric checks but failed the independent contact-free assertion. The saved record includes armed skid/ground contacts.
failures.resolution: Preserved in the earlier stopped checkpoint. Geometry-only success was not promoted to full acceptance.

failures.name: Combined-banner field clearance
failures.outcome: 21/22 checks. Minimum 0.663645 m against 0.70 m at return obstacle 0, native time 842.099 s. Seventy below-floor samples. Zero unexpected contacts, 0.11 m payload error, 886.1 s flight, actual disarm.
failures.resolution: Unresolved. The aircraft completed the mission, but the acceptance failure remains. The miss is about 3.64 cm.

failures.name: Operator-interrupted field run
failures.outcome: The next laid-only field trial was stopped in outbound banner alignment, then landed/disarmed with GRADE_FAIL and ABORTED_RTL.
failures.resolution: Retained as interrupted evidence. It is not a naturally completed mission or a claimed 900 s violation.

failures.name: Strong gusts and coupled artificial delay
failures.outcome: Obstacle-contact/return failures remain. A wider lidar filter was rejected because it could erase thin obstacles.
failures.resolution: Explicitly deferred and excluded. No obstacle removal or threshold relaxation was used.

failures.name: First Pi rendered connection
failures.outcome: FCU connected but sensor WebSockets closed; camera, lidar and clock became stale. No arm/start trial was run.
failures.resolution: Added the receiver loop needed for heartbeat replies. Original failed attempt retained.

failures.name: Second Pi rendered connection
failures.outcome: Camera processing queued frames, closed the stream and disrupted other channels. No flight was attempted.
failures.resolution: Changed transport scheduling to a newest-frame inbox and independent reader, with camera failure separated from clock/lidar.

failures.name: Third connection preflight
failures.outcome: QR health went silent while the camera was in a non-QR pose; lidar wall-clock rate looked below 8 Hz despite 10 Hz capture-clock input.
failures.resolution: QR reports NOT_VISIBLE health; lidar evaluates capture-clock rate and steady-time loss. Focused checks and disarmed readiness passed. Flight proof is still absent.

failures.name: Latest offline run
failures.outcome: After 1,955 passes and eight skips, Node rejected a TypeScript constructor parameter property in ApiError. The full command exited FAILED.
failures.resolution: Fixed the TypeScript syntax; 25 frontend checks and build passed afterward. Further readiness fixes mean a complete final suite is still required.

failures.name: Earlier banner performance run
failures.outcome: An earlier loaded merge trial failed the 100 ms/frame benchmark at about 214 ms/frame. A quiet full run passed afterward.
failures.resolution: Both records retained. The quiet pass does not establish worst-case detector throughput under Pi flight load.

failures.name: Development/deployment failures
failures.outcome: ROS import/test-runner and NumPy ABI conflicts, Windows/WSL file issues, reserved port 8090, WSL mirrored networking failure, Pi download failure, CRLF scripts, root-owned SQLite state and stale built asset references interrupted progress.
failures.resolution: Individual fixes and receipts exist. WSL now uses NAT with an explicit two-port relay. Reboot and integrated recovery verification remains incomplete.

failures.name: Telemetry and readiness inconsistencies
failures.outcome: Latest saved magnetic units are implausible. That same sample shows overall readiness true while the separate EKF display is UNKNOWN and stale markers remain.
failures.resolution: These are unresolved verification findings, not proof of a specific root cause. Reconcile units and readiness/display sources before treating the indication as reliable.

failures.name: Stop-time Pi access
failures.outcome: HTTP at 192.168.0.100:8899 and SSH at 192.168.0.100 timed out. No laptop simulator/relay/recorder was found active.
failures.resolution: Implementation stopped. Current Pi runtime and armed state cannot be certified remotely. Last recorded mission state was idle and disarmed; no mission Start or arm was sent during this integration.
